origin: All NPC parts share (0,0,0) at sole center; apply zero local transform when assembling.
rigging_status: Shared deform skeleton with per-vertex skin weights; authored keyframe actions. No runtime code.
compatibility: Both heads accept both hair styles and all outfits. Shared body silhouette avoids sex-specific outfit copies.
Priest skirt excludes pelvis, thighs and shins. Feet remain visible.
One mesh per slot; -1 means empty; indices are scoped to slot and append-only in v1.
headgear slot 20 is appended; slots 0-19 and original part indices are unchanged.
All headwear replaces visible hair. Keep hair_style_index as latent identity; restore hair slot from it when unequipping.
Open helm, cap, mitre and hoods preserve the selected head. Headwear is shared by both sexes.
Closed helmet keeps the selected real head. Only hair is hidden; head slot must match sex_index.
